title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In Haiti, GOAL’s ICSP is strengthening the resilience of vulnerable communities in the Grand'Anse and Ouest departments, reaching 25,322 people in 2024. ICSP is empowering local institutions and community-based organisations to better respond to natural hazards. In fishing communities, where access to financial services was previously lacking, 10 village savings and loan groups were established to support economic stability. Training and material support for sustainable fishing, alongside pilots in apiculture, mangrove zone mapping using drones, and artificial coral reef installation, have helped diversify income sources. Additionally, mangrove restoration and seafood processing initiatives are enhancing environmental conservation and livelihoods. The project prioritises vulnerable groups, including people with disabilities, those in underserved neighborhoods, and economically marginalised women, ensuring they have the resources and support needed to build a more secure future.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome1: People Survive Crises. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Through strengthening capacity of local partner organisations, early warning systems for climatic shocks (using digital technology) will be adopted to coordinate responses to climate hazards and emergencies. This includes the devleopment of local resilience strategies and Community Response Plans
